versions.subject: Hidden Linux Binary Execution (#3108)
versions.detection:
selection:
    type: 'PATH'
    name|contains: '/.'
filter:
    name|contains:
        - '/.cache/'
        - '/.config/'
        - '/.pyenv/'
        - '/.rustup/toolchains'
condition: selection and not filter
